_README: GiriKavach shared data contract v1.0. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Neither developer changes a field name, unit, or enum value without the other agreeing in the PR. Schema drift between the FastAPI backend and the XGBoost/Streamlit side is the #1 integration risk on this project.

sensor_reading._description: One merged sample. Node 1 (mountain, via LoRa) + Node 2 (gateway, local sensors). This is the POST body for /ingest.

node_id._note: Every reading must carry node identity. Needed so the PWA can filter alerts to the user's valley.

timestamp_utc._note: ALWAYS UTC on the wire. Convert to IST for display only, never in storage or transport.

rain_duration_min._note: Minutes of continuous active rain in the current event, not total uptime.

soil_moisture_profile._description: RECONCILED FIELD. Rakesh's dashboard uses a 5-depth profile; the ML models and firmware use a single deep value. Node reports ALL depths; deep_soil_moisture_pct is DERIVED from them by the backend so both consumers are satisfied from one source.

deep_soil_moisture_pct._derivation: Weighted mean of the 30cm/60cm/100cm layers (the slip-plane band), weights 0.25/0.45/0.30. Computed by the backend, NOT sent by the node. If only one physical sensor exists (current hardware), it reports into soil_moisture_30cm_pct and this value equals it.
deep_soil_moisture_pct._note: This is the field BOTH ML models consume. Do not change its meaning.

slope_pitch_deg._note: From MPU6050 pitch. Static site slope can also be pre-loaded from Bhuvan DEM as a fallback.

pitch_rate_deg_min._note: Rate of tilt change = creep signal.

vibration_intensity._note: SW-420 pulse count over a rolling 15s window, normalized.

stream_depth_cm._note: Water depth = sensor_mount_height - ultrasonic_distance. Median-filtered over 10 readings before use.

rate_of_rise_cm_min._note: dh/dt from consecutive depth readings. >5 cm/min triggers the dam-break safety net REGARDLESS of ML output.

node1_link_fresh._note: False when no LoRa packet in 5 min. When false, landslide inference is SKIPPED (all its features originate at node1) — this is NOT a low-risk finding.

ml_feature_vectors._description: EXACT ordered feature lists. Both the XGBoost models and the TFLM models consume these in THIS ORDER. Changing the order silently corrupts predictions with no error.

output._note: Regressor output, clamped to [0,100] by the backend.

risk_tiers._description: ONE source of truth. Identical strings in firmware, backend, dashboard, PWA, and CAP mapping.

cap_mapping._description: Internal tier -> CAP 1.2 controlled vocabulary. certainty is never 'Observed' from a prediction alone.
cap_mapping._status_note: NEVER default to 'Actual'. CAP is consumed by real emergency infrastructure; a demo payload marked Actual is a false emergency claim.

safety_net_thresholds._description: Raw-physics overrides. These fire the siren REGARDLESS of ML output, and bypass hysteresis. Defence against a silently-wrong model (e.g. the rainless GLOF case).

api_endpoints._description: Backend contract. Rakesh's dashboard and the PWA both consume these.

decision_object._description: What /ingest and /status return. This is what the dashboard and PWA render.
decision_object.reasons: array of strings — why it escalated
decision_object.suppressed: array of strings — what was rejected and why

heartbeat._note: Dashboard and PWA both use stale_after_seconds to show the node-offline chip. One value, both consumers.
